% Data: figures/data/latency.csv, generated by scripts/make_figures.py from
% research/v3-standard-installed-evidence-20261017.md (resident request-to-receiver cost).
\definecolor{pvblue}{RGB}{0,114,178}
\definecolor{pvorange}{RGB}{213,94,0}
\definecolor{pvgreen}{RGB}{0,158,115}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[
  width=\columnwidth, height=4.2cm, ybar, bar width=3.2pt, ymode=log, ymin=1, ymax=1000,
  symbolic x coords={fetch-Off,fetch-Rules/NER,fetch-Semantic,fetch-Full,XHR-Off,XHR-Rules/NER,XHR-Semantic,XHR-Full},
  xtick=data, xticklabels={Off,R/N,Sem,Full,Off,R/N,Sem,Full}, enlarge x limits=0.07,
  ylabel={Latency (ms, log scale)}, ymajorgrids, tick label style={font=\small}, label style={font=\small},
  legend style={font=\small, at={(0.5,1.04)}, anchor=south, legend columns=3, draw=none},
  extra x ticks={fetch-Rules/NER,XHR-Rules/NER}, extra x tick labels={{fetch},{XHR}},
  extra x tick style={xticklabel style={yshift=-1.1em}, tick style={draw=none}},
]
\addplot[fill=pvblue, draw=pvblue] table[x=cell, y=p50, col sep=comma]{figures/data/latency.csv};
\addplot[fill=pvorange, draw=pvorange] table[x=cell, y=p95, col sep=comma]{figures/data/latency.csv};
\addplot[fill=pvgreen!35, draw=pvgreen] table[x=cell, y=max, col sep=comma]{figures/data/latency.csv};
\legend{p50, p95, Maximum}
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
